nina: Quick note — while doing a canary run of q4b-int8 against float16 I saw systematic embedding drift on the promptbank holdout. Dedupe buckets shifted for ~1.2% of samples, and top-1 nearest neighbor pairs diverged.

omar: can you paste the top diffs? :eyes:

nina: here's a tiny sample (holdout ids, baseline nn id -> q4b-int8 nn id):
```
12345: 987 -> 901
12346: 450 -> 450
12347: 772 -> 883
12348: 111 -> 222
```

anya: is tokenizer version the same between runs? we've had tokenization drift before.

nina: good call — canary was on tokenizer-v2 build. baseline eval used tokenizer-v1. I re-ran quick fingerprint compare; overlap dropped from 98.6% -> 97.4%.

kevin: that delta is small but could affect dedupe-labeled cohorts. Suggest we pause the current labeling batch for this cohort and run newer tokenizer across the bank to normalize.

omar: @nina can you add a quick repro command so ops can re-run locally? I'll freeze labeler queue if it's reproducible.

nina: repro:
```
python tools/compare_embeddings.py \
  --models q4b-int8,float16 \
  --prompts data/promptbank/holdout-2026-03.json \
  --tokenizer builds/tokenizer-v2 \
  --out tmp/emb-diff.csv
```

ops-bot: labeler-queue status: 2 active batches, 1 queued for cohort 'promptbank-v2'.

omar: pausing queued batch 'promptbank-v2' now. :white_check_mark:

anya: while paused, recommend we run a small canary to regenerate fingerprints with tokenizer-v2 and run eval metrics (recall@1, mean-sim delta). I can kick that off.

kevin: also update the golden set docs — note tokenizer version in metadata so future brings don't mismatch. small PR ok?

nina: will open a tiny PR with tokenizer tag in golden metadata and attach the emb-diff csv. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
